pages.mainText: Welcome to Dotdigital Careers Connect Job openings Scroll to content Dotdigital is made up of 400+ employees, spread across 5 continents. Dotvoice Dotvoice is an employee led initiative focusing on 4 pillars - Dotcommunity, DotDEI, Dotgreen and Dotwellbeing. It’s not all hard work From our July and Christmas parties to Dotlunches and team outings, our dedicated Dotcommunity makes sure there’s always a healthy balance of work and play. Room to grow Many of our employees have grown with the business and now hold senior positions. We provide a supportive environment and tools for our employees to grow and succeed. Other initiatives we're proud to shout about... Tech Talent Charter We are very excited to be part of the Tech Talent Charter which focuses on bringing together organizations to drive greater diversity and inclusion in technology roles! Go green! We are very focused on green initiatives as a company!Our main focus being:ISO StandardsCurrently Carbon NeutralWill be Net Zero by 2030 Menopause Workplace Pledge We are committed to supporting our staff at every stage of their career, that’s why we have signed up to the Menopause Workplace Pledge The Girls' Network We are incredibly proud to be a corporate partner of The Girls' Network in the UK!The Girls' Network aims to inspire and empower girls from the least advantaged communities by connecting them to a mentor and a network of professional role models who are women.We know that women are underrepresented in the tech industry, so we're incredibly excited to partner with such a fantastic charity to inspire the next generation of young women. Disability Confident Employer We are proud to be a Disability Confident Employer and have committed to:ensure our recruitment process is inclusive and accessiblecommunicating and promoting vacanciesoffering an interview to disabled people who meet the minimum criteria for the jobanticipating and providing reasonable adjustments as requiredsupporting any existing employee who acquires a disability or long term health condition, enabling them to stay in workat least one activity that will make a difference for disabled people Meet our team! Andrew Gretton CTO Hayley Monk Head of Talent Acquisition Ashley Baltz Head of Sales, Americas Harley Stevens Website Manager Ryan Raymond Campaign Marketing Manager Danny Rendle Development Lead Ian Tilson Head of Partnerships - APAC Blake Jackson Global Head of Marketing More people Our tech stack Backend Majority C# (dotnet 6, 7, with some Framework)Some NodeJS, some Python for data science, and PHP for ecommerce integrations Frontend Angular 15+ (some older AngularJS)ASP.NET (webapi, some older mvc+webforms which we’re phasing out)TS/ES6/gulp/grunt/node/yarnSass Data SQL ServerGoogle BigQueryAzure CosmosDBRedisMongoDB Infrastructure Cloud: Majority Azure; some GCP; some AWSContainerized (mostly Linux containers, some Windows containers)Terraform/ARM/IaCAzure Service Bus/Event HubsRabbitMQ Tooling Azure DevOpsVisual Studio/Rider/VS Code/PyCharm/PhpStormnUnit/Moq/Robot FrameworkElastic Search/Kibana/Prometheus/Grafana Our global benefits Parental leave Having a child is one of the biggest moments of your life and whether you’re a mum or dad, we understand the importance the time off work gives you to bond with your family. That’s why we offer an enhanced paternity, maternity and adoption leave policy for new parents. Medical cover We offer medical insurance in all our global locations for our employees to feel reassured and offer options to look after their health and feel supported. Paid sick leave When you’re unwell, you don’t want the added worry of whether you’re going to be paid for time off. That’s why we offer a company paid sick leave policy to support you when you need it. Dotdigital day On top of your annual leave allowance and the holiday closedown period, we give you an extra day’s paid leave per year to use as you wish. It could be a day off on your birthday or a family birthday, a day to move house, or an opportunity to take advantage of the sunny weather! Share reward Those who qualify may be granted a number of share options at no cost to themselves with the option to exercise these shares in the future. Wellbeing reward Everyone has different ways of keeping themselves happy and healthy – the wellbeing reward is a flexible benefit that you can use towards an activity, hobby or membership. MyPossibleSelf We recognise the importance of having on hand mental health and wellbeing support when you need it most. That is why we have a MyPossibleSelf wellbeing app membership for all Dotdigital employees. Wellbeing Days As part of our continued support of employee wellbeing we want to provide you with time to support family, dependents, yourselves, and worthy causes. Loyalty reward We’re proud to have employees who’ve been with the company since day dot and we believe loyalty is definitely something worth celebrating. So, for your first 5 years of service, and every additional 5 years’ service beyond that, have dinner and drinks on us. Specific policies to support our employees There may be times where your personal circumstances can be challenging and mean you require some additional support from us. That is why we have internal policies on Bereavement, Babyloss, Menopause and Fertility Support to ensure you feel supported during this time. ⚠️ Warning - Beware of fake job postings or offers! ⚠️ We recently found out malicious parties are impersonating Dotdigital to advertise illegitimate job vacancies. To protect yourself, it's vital to make sure you only apply for and engage with legitimate job postings.Here's how to stay vigilant: We’ll never contact you through messaging apps like WhatsApp or Telegram. Our preferred communication method is via email, using the domain @message.teamtailor.com (our secure recruitment platform's domain). We’ll conduct all interviews either in person or through video calls. We’ll never request any form of payment during our hiring process. If you suspect you've encountered a false job vacancy or simply want to verify the authenticity of a a vacancy, please reach out to us at security@dotdigital.com Our open positions: Senior Account Executive Sales · Sydney · Hybrid Agency Enablement Associate - Alia Alia · Multiple locations · Fully Remote Business Development Representative - Alia Alia · New York · Onsite Business Development Representative Sales · London Bridge, Manchester · Hybrid Integration Engineer Product & Technology · South Africa · Fully Remote Customer Success Manager Customer Success · Japan · Hybrid Marketing Manager - Alia Alia · New York Information Security Analyst Product & Technology · Remote, UK, South Africa · Fully Remote Digital Project Manager Professional Services · Sydney · Hybrid All jobs London Bridge California Canada Cape Town Cheltenham Costa Rica Croydon Florida Honduras Japan Manchester Melbourne New Jersey New York North Carolina Poland Remote, UK Singapore South Africa Sydney About Dotdigital Dotdigital is a thriving global community of passionate, dedicated professionals, committed to the collective success of the organization and its clients. Our core principles of innovation, teamwork, and client-focused solutions drive us to approach challenges with a growth mindset and take ownership of our work. Get started Company About us Contact us Trust Center Investor Careers Partner Tech partners Agency partners Become a partner AI at work. Human at heart. Dotdigital is the only marketing personalization platform with AI at its core and marketers leading the way. Get started Speak to the team 25+ years of experience Our technology has evolved. Our interface looks different. But our fundamentals remain the same - provide a solution to marketing challenges. Big and small. Even after all this time, we stay ahead by focusing on delivering what marketers need, through acquisition and organic growth. 4000+ amazing customers Organizations of all sizes, from all industries, across the world use Dotdigital. Our customers are our inspiration and we grow as they grow. 450+ incredible team members Our team is the perfect balance of tech specialists, customer support experts, creatives, and world-class operational specialists behind the scenes. We’re a diverse bunch who all bring different skills, traits, and experience. But we also have a lot in common; we love dogs, we love to be social, and we absolutely love the work we do. A truly global culture Our global strategy takes a local approach, with experts in the center of every region we serve. Our teams are constantly in contact with our customers and each other, sharing learnings and insights across countries and time zones. Focused on inclusivity & diversity DEI is more than an acronym at Dotdigital. We publish an annual diversity report alongside our gender pay gap report and have a dedicated employee group who champion the topic across all areas of our culture, brand, processes and policies. As part of our DEI commitment, we’ve established: Employee guidance on day-to-day DEI principles at work Annual reporting on diversity and inclusion numbers An open culture where we’re not afraid to be challenged, with processes for anonymous questions and feedback An inclusive recruitment and hiring process Adaptable ways of working for flexibility, accessibility, wellbeing, and family support Marketing made human Why Dotdigital? We’re serious about sustainability Dotdigital is the world’s first carbon-neutral marketing automation platform. But we’re not stopping there. Our goal is to go beyond carbon neutrality and become net zero by 2030. Our sustainability achievements include: Being ISO 14001 certified since January 2021 (international standard for Environmental Management Systems) Working with ClimateCare to eliminate and offset carbon emissions A platform powered by 100% renewable energy An employee working group committed to sustainability education and improvements across our global offices A supplier selection process that rewards vendors who are also powered by 100% renewable energy “Our focus at Dotdigital is simple, help marketers deliver cross-channel campaigns that genuinely connect with their audiences.” Milan Patel CEO, Dotdigital “We have the pleasure of working with some of the most ambitious marketers in the world, and their goals inspire our own marketing every day.” Blake Jackson Global Head of Marketing, Dotdigital “From day one, we’ve built our platform in collaboration with our ecosystem, helping marketers solve real challenges.” Tink Taylor Co-founder & VP, Dotdigital Our company values We hold ourselves accountable to bringing the Dotdigital ethos to life by living and breathing our company values: The Dotdigital C.O.D.E. Collaborate - we work together, share ideas, and support each other Open - we’re honest, we listen, we communicate clearly, and we love feedback Diverse - we value different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences Enjoy - we bring positivity, we celebrate progress, and we have fun along the way A Dotdigital deep dive Can I see a demo of Dotdigital? Of course! Just fill in your details here, and one of our experts will be in touch to capture some more details so we can show you a demo tailored to your business and what you’re looking to achieve. Can any organization become a Dotdigital partner? Our partner network is a really important part of our business and we work with over 1000 partners worldwide. We establish partnerships where there is most value for our joint customers, or potential customers. To find out more about becoming a Dotdigital partner and to discuss with one of our team, fill out this quick form. What makes Dotdigital carbon neutral? To achieve carbon neutrality, we offset all measured Scope 1 and 2 emissions plus selected Scope 3 emissions (including business travel, remote workers, employee commuting, major cloud infrastructure providers, data centers, and transmission and distribution losses). Our platform also runs on infrastructure powered by 100% renewable energy. How do I find out about product developments? We share a quarterly summary of our latest product releases on the What’s New page on our website, as well as via our blog and email. Make sure you’re subscribed to our emails to hear first about what’s new. You can also see what we’re working on at any time via our public-facing roadmap and submit feedback or suggestions. Our roadmap is shaped by this feedback from marketers. If you’re a Dotdigital customer, your Customer Success Manager can give you a tailored run-through of what’s new and how it can help your business. How do I stay up to date with your events and content? All our upcoming events are posted on the Events page on our website. You can check out our lastest blogs, guides, videos and case studies in our resources library. How do I request a new feature or platform development? Our roadmap is built based on feedback from customers and we love to receive your suggestions. You can share your thoughts on what you’d like to see next via our public facing roadmap. How much does Dotdigital cost? We don’t believe in paying for things you don’t use, so we carefully tailor pricing for every customer. Our pricing is calculated based on a combination of: - How many marketable contacts are in your database - How many messages you plan to send Book a call to get an accurate quote based on your requirements. pages.mainText: 会社概要 私たちについて お問い合わせ トラストセンター 投資家 採用情報 パートナー 技術パートナー 導入パートナー パートナーになる 日本語ENG ログイン プラットフォーム 業界 スタートしましょう！ 会社概要 私たちについて お問い合わせ トラストセンター 投資家 採用情報 パートナー 技術パートナー 導入パートナー パートナーになる 仕事ではAI。心は人間。 Dotdigitalは、AIを中核に据え、マーケターが主導する唯一のマーケティング・パーソナライゼーション・プラットフォームです。 はじめに チームにご相談ください 25年以上の経験 当社の技術は進化し、インターフェースも変わりました。しかし、マーケティングの課題に対する解決策を提供するという基本方針は変わりません。その課題の規模の大小を問わず、長年にわたり、買収や有機的な成長を通じて、マーケターが必要とするものを提供することに注力することで、常に業界をリードし続けています。 4000名以上の素晴らしいお客様 世界中のあらゆる業界、あらゆる規模の組織がDotdigitalを利用しています。お客様こそが私たちの原動力であり、お客様の成長とともに私たちも成長しています。 450名以上の素晴らしいチームメンバー 私たちのチームは、技術専門家、カスタマーサポートのエキスパート、クリエイティブスタッフ、そして舞台裏で支える世界トップクラスの運営スペシャリストが、絶妙なバランスで結集しています。私たちは多様なメンバーで構成されており、それぞれが異なるスキル、個性、経験を持っています。しかし、共通点もたくさんあります。私たちは犬が大好きで、人と交流するのが大好きで、そして自分たちの仕事を心から愛しています。 真にグローバルな文化 当社のグローバル戦略は、各地域に専門家を配置し、現地に根差したアプローチを採用しています。各チームは、お客様やチームメンバーと常に連携を取り合い、国やタイムゾーンを越えて知見や洞察を共有しています。 インクルージョンとダイバーシティを重視 Dotdigitalにおいて、DEIは単なる頭字語以上の意味を持っています。当社は、男女間の賃金格差報告書と併せて年次ダイバーシティ報告書を発行しており、企業文化、ブランド、プロセス、方針のあらゆる分野においてこのテーマを推進する専任の従業員グループを設置しています。 DEIへの取り組みの一環として、当社は以下の取り組みを確立しました： 職場における日々のDEI原則に関する従業員向け指針 ダイバーシティとインクルージョンに関する数値の年次報告 挑戦を恐れないオープンな文化と、匿名での質問やフィードバックを受け付ける仕組み 包括的な採用・選考プロセス 柔軟性、アクセシビリティ、ウェルビーイング、および家族支援を実現するための適応性の高い働き方 人間味あふれるマーケティング Dotdigitalが選ばれる理由 私たちは持続可能性を真剣に考えています Dotdigitalは、世界初のカーボンニュートラルなマーケティングオートメーションプラットフォームです。しかし、私たちはそこで満足しません。私たちの目標は、カーボンニュートラルにとどまらず、2030年までにネットゼロを実現することです。 当社のサステナビリティに関する実績には、以下のものが含まれます： 2021年1月よりISO 14001（環境マネジメントシステムの国際規格）の認証を取得しています。 ClimateCareと連携し、二酸化炭素排出量の削減とオフセットに取り組む 100％再生可能エネルギーで稼働するプラットフォーム 当社の世界各地のオフィスにおいて、サステナビリティに関する教育と改善に取り組む従業員ワーキンググループ 100％再生可能エネルギーを利用しているベンダーを優遇するサプライヤー選定プロセス 「Dotdigitalの取り組みはシンプルです。それは、マーケターがオーディエンスと真に心を通わせるクロスチャネルキャンペーンを展開できるよう支援することです。」 ミラン・パテル Dotdigital 最高経営責任者（CEO） 「私たちは、世界で最も意欲的なマーケターの方々とお仕事できることを光栄に思っており、彼らの目標は、私たちのマーケティング活動に日々刺激を与えてくれています。」 Blake Jackson Global Head of Marketing, Dotdigital 「創業当初から、私たちはエコシステムと連携してプラットフォームを構築し、マーケターが直面する現実的な課題の解決を支援してきました。」 ティンク・テイラー Dotdigital 共同創業者兼副社長 当社の企業理念 私たちは、企業理念「The Dotdigital C.O.D.E.」を体現し、その精神を生き生きと実践することで、Dotdigitalの理念を具現化する責任を果たしています。 「協力」――私たちは共に働き、アイデアを共有し、互いに支え合います オープンな姿勢― 私たちは誠実であり、相手の話に耳を傾け、明確に意思疎通を図り、フィードバックを歓迎します 多様性― 私たちは、さまざまな視点、背景、経験を大切にしています ぜひお楽しみください。私たちは前向きな姿勢を大切にし、進歩を祝い、その過程を楽しみながら進んでいます。 Dotdigitalの徹底解説 Dotdigitalのデモを見ることができますか？ もちろんです！こちらに必要事項をご入力いただければ、当社の専門家からご連絡を差し上げ、さらに詳しい情報をお伺いした上で、お客様のビジネスやご要望に合わせたデモをご案内いたします。 どのような組織でも、Dotdigitalのパートナーになることはできますか？ 当社のパートナーネットワークは、事業において非常に重要な役割を果たしており、世界中で1000社以上のパートナーと提携しています。 当社は、共通のお客様や見込み客にとって最大の価値が生まれる分野において、パートナーシップを構築しています。Dotdigitalのパートナーになることについて詳しく知りたい方、または当社の担当者との相談をご希望の方は、こちらの簡単なフォームにご記入ください。 Dotdigitalがカーボンニュートラルである理由は何ですか？ カーボンニュートラルを達成するため、当社は、測定されたすべてのスコープ1およびスコープ2の排出量に加え、特定のスコープ3の排出量（出張、リモートワーク、従業員の通勤、主要なクラウドインフラプロバイダー、データセンター、送電・配電損失など）をオフセットしています。 また、当社のプラットフォームは、100％再生可能エネルギーで稼働するインフラ上で運用されています。 製品の開発状況については、どのように確認すればよいですか？ 当社のウェブサイトにある「新着情報」ページや、ブログ、メールを通じて、最新の製品リリースに関する四半期ごとの概要をお知らせしています。新着情報をいち早くお受け取りいただくため、ぜひメールマガジンの購読をお申し込みください。 また、一般公開されているロードマップを通じて、当社が現在取り組んでいる内容をいつでも確認し、フィードバックや提案を送信することもできます。当社のロードマップは、マーケターの皆様からのこうしたフィードバックを基に策定されています。 リソースライブラリでは、最新のブログ記事、ガイド、動画、ケーススタディをご覧いただけます。 新機能やプラットフォームの開発を依頼するにはどうすればよいですか？ 当社のロードマップは、お客様からのフィードバックに基づいて作成されており、皆様からのご提案を心よりお待ちしております。 公開されているロードマップを通じて、今後どのような機能を実装してほしいか、ご意見をお寄せください。 Business review Our product offering Dotdigital’s AI powered platform gives marketers a single suite of products based upon real-time data to connect with their customers more effectively. We help our customers create and manage automated personalised communications and understand customer behaviour across multiple channels. Key elements of the suite include:
...
Rather than adding more tools, organisations are prioritising fewer, interoperable enterprise grade systems that plug into existing commerce and CRM platforms and can be rolled out across brands and regions without the risk of a single global ‘rip and replace’ implementation process. Our breadth of native channels and deep connector set – now extended with Fresh Relevance for web personalisation and Social Snowball for influencer, affiliate and referral programmes – positions the Group as a practical consolidation choice for mid-market and enterprise customers. AI is now expected to make a tangible impact. Marketers expect measurable gains in speed, quality and return on investment, not gimmicks or window-dressing. Our 15+ years of investment into AI, culminating in the launch of WinstonAI in 2023, along with our reporting enhancements, meet that brief; assisting with content, imagery and analysis inside existing workflows, while the underlying platform enables predictive and real-time use cases as customers mature.
...
Financial Review Business Model We sell access to our CXDP and messaging (email, SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, push) on 1–3 year contracts priced by modules taken, data volumes and message volumes. Revenue is recognised evenly over the contract life under IFRS 15, with customers able to upgrade during term as usage grows. Fresh Relevance, acquired in FY24, added website-personalisation capability and an additional pricing lever via page-view volumes. In late June 2025 we acquired Social Snowball, a subscription SaaS product for influencer, affiliate and referral programmes. Social Snowball’s revenues are recognised in the same way as our other software revenues, albeit the vast majority of contracts are currently month-to-month. The product broadens our addressable market and increases cross-sell potential, with a margin profile consistent with the Group. Professional services remain a small contributor (well under 5% of Group revenue) and are recognised as delivered.
